# PhoenixKitCatalogue v0.9.0 - Table of Contents

> Catalogue module for PhoenixKit — manufacturers, suppliers, and product catalogues.

## Pages

- Guides
  - [Smart Catalogues](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/smart_catalogues.md)

## Modules

- [PhoenixKitCatalogue](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.md): Catalogue module for PhoenixKit.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.AITranslatable](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.AITranslatable.md): `PhoenixKitAI.Translatable` adapter for catalogue resources —
the small per-module hook into PhoenixKitAI's generic AI-translation pipeline.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.AITranslateBinding](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.AITranslateBinding.md): `PhoenixKitAI.Components.AITranslate.FormBinding` for catalogue forms —
the storage-specific half of the shared AI-translate glue.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Attachments](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Attachments.md): Folder-scoped file attachments + featured image for catalogue
resources (items and catalogues share the exact same pattern).
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.md): Context module for managing catalogues, manufacturers, suppliers, categories, and items.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Counts](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Counts.md): Catalogue-level item and category counts. Includes both per-uuid
helpers and single-query batch versions to avoid N+1 lookups when
rendering catalogue lists with associated item / category counts.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Links](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Links.md): Manufacturer ↔ Supplier many-to-many links.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Manufacturers](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Manufacturers.md): Manufacturers — company directory used as the source of items.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.PdfLibrary](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.PdfLibrary.md): PDF library — upload, extract, search.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.PubSub](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.PubSub.md): Real-time fan-out for catalogue mutations.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Rules](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Rules.md): Smart-catalogue rules — one row per `(item, referenced_catalogue)` pair.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Search](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Search.md): Item search — global, per-catalogue, and per-category, with optional
scope composition (`catalogue_uuids` AND `category_uuids`).
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.SmartPricing](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.SmartPricing.md): Public smart-pricing evaluator — the canonical implementation of the
algorithm previously documented as a copy-paste reference in
`guides/smart_catalogues.md`.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Suppliers](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Suppliers.md): Suppliers — delivery companies linked to manufacturers via the
many-to-many `phoenix_kit_cat_manufacturer_suppliers` table.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Translations](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue.Translations.md): Multilang `data` JSONB helpers — read merged language data from a
record and write language-specific overrides through the entity's own
update function.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Errors](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Errors.md): Central mapping from error atoms (returned by `PhoenixKitCatalogue.Catalogue`
and the import pipeline) to translated, user-facing strings.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.md): Export context for the Catalogue module.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.Destination](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.Destination.md): Behaviour for export destinations (e.g. PRO100, Universal).
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.Pro100](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.Pro100.md): PRO100 export destination.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.Universal](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.Universal.md): Universal export destination.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.UniversalJson](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Export.UniversalJson.md): Universal JSON export encoder.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Gettext](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Gettext.md): Gettext backend for phoenix_kit_catalogue.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.CommaParser](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.CommaParser.md)
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.Executor](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.Executor.md): Executes an import plan by creating categories and items.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.Mapper](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.Mapper.md): Maps file columns to catalogue fields and transforms row data into
validated item attribute maps ready for insertion.

- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.Parser](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.Parser.md): Parses XLSX and CSV files into structured row data.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.SemicolonParser](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.SemicolonParser.md)
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.TabParser](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Import.TabParser.md)
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Metadata](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Metadata.md): Global, code-defined list of metadata fields that catalogue resources
(items and catalogues) can opt into.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Paths](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Paths.md): Centralized path helpers for the Catalogue module.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Catalogue](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Catalogue.md): Schema for catalogues — top-level groupings (e.g., Kitchen Furniture, Plumbing).
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.CatalogueRule](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.CatalogueRule.md): Smart-catalogue rule: one row per `(item, referenced_catalogue)` pair.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Category](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Category.md): Schema for categories within a catalogue.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Folder](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Folder.md): Schema for catalogue folders — a nesting layer for organizing catalogues
on the admin index. Folders are module-global (not scoped to a catalogue)
and are unrelated to the media-folder system.

- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Item](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Item.md): Schema for catalogue items — individual products/materials with SKU and pricing.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Manufacturer](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Manufacturer.md): Schema for manufacturers.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.ManufacturerSupplier](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.ManufacturerSupplier.md): Join table linking manufacturers to suppliers (many-to-many).
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Pdf](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Pdf.md): Per-upload row in the catalogue's PDF library.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.PdfExtraction](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.PdfExtraction.md): Extraction state for one unique PDF file content.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.PdfPage](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.PdfPage.md): Per-page join row keyed by `(file_uuid, page_number)`.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.PdfPageContent](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.PdfPageContent.md): Content-addressed cache of PDF page text.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Supplier](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Schemas.Supplier.md): Schema for suppliers.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.CatalogueDetailLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.CatalogueDetailLive.md): Detail view for a single catalogue, with infinite-scroll paging over
its categories and items.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.CatalogueFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.CatalogueFormLive.md): Create/edit form for catalogues with multilang support.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.CataloguesLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.CataloguesLive.md): Landing page for the Catalogue module.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.CategoryFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.CategoryFormLive.md): Create/edit form for categories within a catalogue.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Components](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Components.md): Reusable UI components for the Catalogue module.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Components.ItemPicker](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Components.ItemPicker.md): Combobox LiveComponent for picking a single item from the catalogue
via server-side search.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Components.PdfSearchModal](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Components.PdfSearchModal.md): LiveComponent that searches the PDF library for any page whose
text matches one of the given item's translated names.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.EventsLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.EventsLive.md): LiveView for the catalogue activity events subtab.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ExportController](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ExportController.md): Stateless controller for the catalogue export download.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ExportLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ExportLive.md): Export tab LiveView.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Helpers](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Helpers.md): Tiny utilities shared by every catalogue LiveView. Imported into LVs
via the standard `import PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Helpers` line.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ImportLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ImportLive.md): Multi-step import wizard for catalogue items.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ItemFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ItemFormLive.md): Create/edit form for catalogue items with multilang support.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ManufacturerFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.ManufacturerFormLive.md): Create/edit form for manufacturers with supplier linking.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.PdfDetailLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.PdfDetailLive.md): Single-PDF detail page. Shows metadata + extraction status, embeds
the vendored PDF.js viewer in an iframe pre-bound to the file and
the optional `?page=N` URL param.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.PdfLibraryLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.PdfLibraryLive.md): Admin index for the PDF library subtab.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Routes](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.Routes.md): Route module for PhoenixKit Catalogue admin routes.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.SupplierFormLive](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Web.SupplierFormLive.md): Create/edit form for suppliers with manufacturer linking.
- [PhoenixKitCatalogue.Workers.PdfExtractor](https://phoenix-kit-catalogue.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixKitCatalogue.Workers.PdfExtractor.md): Oban worker that extracts text page-by-page from a PDF using
`pdfinfo` (page count) + `pdftotext` (per-page text).
